rule: Mission zones restrict remote rover/drone operation through signal quality, static feedback, disabled-drone beacons, line-of-sight rescue pulls, and distance-based recovery instead of invisible walls.

required_controls.lmb_on_disabled_drone: lock rescue cable when line-of-sight allows

reject_if: mission zone becomes an invisible wall
disabled drones can still be controlled
rescue has no beacon or line-of-sight check
